remarks:
Escape to the peaceful hills of Allegany County with this exceptional recreational property offering the perfect start for your dream cabin retreat. Situated in a quiet country setting, this property features electric service already on site and an approximate 24' x 26' cabin ready for the next owner to complete and customize to their own style and vision. Whether you're looking for a hunting camp, weekend getaway, family retreat, this property offers a great opportunity. Outdoor enthusiasts will appreciate the property's outstanding location nearby thousands of acres of New York State land. You'll find nearby access to 
Bully Hill State Forest, Palmer's Pond State Forest, Jersey Hill State Forest, Slader Creek State Forest, Turnpike State Forest, Karr Valley Creek State Forest, Gas Springs State Forest, Phillips Creek State Forest. Together, these nearby state forests offer thousands of acres of public land for hunting, hiking, camping, horseback riding, snowmobiling, wildlife viewing, and year-round outdoor recreation. The nearby West Almond Trail System further expands opportunities for hiking, horseback riding, cross-country skiing, and snowshoeing. If you've been searching for an affordable property where much of the groundwork has already been completed, this is an outstanding opportunity to create your own recreational headquarters in one of Western New York's premier outdoor destinations. Bring your ideas, finish the cabin to your taste, and start making memories for years to come.
